FDA does not require that a causal relationship between a product and event be proven, and reports do not always contain enough detail to properly evaluate an event. field_docs.year: Year FDA received the reports (receivedate). The current year is partial, up to source_last_updated.
field_docs.row_type: year_total = all FAERS reports that year; drug = reports naming that drug
field_docs.rank: Rank of the drug by number of reports that year (1 = most reports); empty on year_total rows

field_docs.reports: Number of reports. Counts are reports, not proven side effects: There is no certainty that the reported event (adverse event or medication error) was actually due to the product. FDA does not require that a causal relationship between a product and event be proven, and reports do not always contain enough detail to properly evaluate an event. Submission of a safety report does not constitute an admission that medical personnel, user facility, importer, distributor, manufacturer or product caused or contributed to the event. Common drugs have more reports because more people take them.
field_docs.serious_reports: Reports coded serious (serious=1). On drug rows empty means below the top-500 cut-off for that year, not zero
field_docs.death_reports: Reports with death recorded as an outcome (seriousnessdeath=1); death is not necessarily caused by the drug. On drug rows empty means below the top-500 cut-off, not zero
field_docs.hospitalisation_reports: Reports with hospitalisation as an outcome (year_total rows only)

field_docs.licence_profile: EPA licence profile number (the site-level record, e.g. P0004). One row per profile. Scope: profiles whose licence type is Industrial Emissions, IPPC or IPC AND whose published major class of activity is 5.16 ("The production of pharmaceutical products including intermediates") or 5.6 (pre-2013 IPC wording: "The manufacture of pesticides, pharmaceuticals or veterinary products and their intermediates") of the First Schedule to the EPA Act 1992 as amended, OR whose IED activity is Annex I 4.5 ("Production of pharmaceutical products including intermediates"). Biologics and vaccine plants are licensed under 5.16; the EPA has no separate biotechnology class. Class 5.6 also covers pesticide and veterinary manufacture
field_docs.licence_number: Registration number of the profile's active licence version (e.g. P0004-06)
field_docs.licence_type: Type of the active licence: Industrial Emissions Licence, Integrated Pollution Prevention Control Licence or Integrated Pollution Control Licence
field_docs.licence_status: Status of the active licence as published by LEAP (e.g. Licensed, Surrendered, Abandoned, Withdrawn)
field_docs.licence_substatus: Sub-status of the active licence as published (e.g. Licensable Activity Commenced); often empty
field_docs.licensee: Organisation that holds the licence, as published by LEAP (company names kept as written, including typos)
field_docs.site_name: Licence profile (site) name as published, without the trailing profile number
field_docs.county: County of the site, as published
field_docs.town: Town or city of the site when LEAP publishes one (site record, else profile); empty for most older profiles

field_docs.sector: EPA sector of the active licence (all rows are Chemicals at the time of collection)
field_docs.activity_class: Major class of activity code under the First Schedule to the EPA Act 1992 as amended (5.16 or 5.6)
field_docs.activity_description: Wording of the major class of activity as published
field_docs.ied_activity_class: Industrial Emissions Directive (2010/75/EU) Annex I activity code (4.5) when published; empty for pre-IED IPC/IPPC profiles
field_docs.ied_activity_description: Wording of the IED activity as published
field_docs.nace_code: NACE Rev. 2 code of the site as recorded by the EPA, without the dot (2110 basic pharmaceutical products, 2120 pharmaceutical preparations, 2014 other organic basic chemicals); empty when not recorded
field_docs.first_licence_date: Earliest date of licence among the profile's licence versions (YYYY-MM-DD); empty when no version has a licence date (e.g. withdrawn applications)

field_docs.expiry_basis: Whether exclusivity_expiry is the Register's recorded end date, a computed date, or not available
field_docs.product_url: Union Register page of the medicine
field_docs.designation_url: Union Register page of the orphan designation

fda_orange_book.name: US FDA Orange Book: drug patents and exclusivities
fda_orange_book.publisher: U.S. Food and Drug Administration (Center for Drug Evaluation and Research)
fda_orange_book.licence: Public domain (U.S. government work): FDA website content is not copyrighted and may be republished freely
fda_orange_book.attribution: Source: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Orange Book: Approved Drug Products with Therapeutic Equivalence Evaluations (data files). Not endorsed by the FDA.

field_docs.record_type: 'patent' (a row of patent.txt) or 'exclusivity' (a row of exclusivity.txt)
field_docs.appl_type: Application type: N = NDA (new drug application), A = ANDA (generic)
field_docs.product_no: Product number within the application (3 digits); appl_type + appl_no + product_no identify a product
field_docs.applicant: Applicant company, full name as listed in the Orange Book
field_docs.dosage_form: Dosage form (part of the Orange Book DF;Route field before the semicolon)
field_docs.route: Route of administration (part of DF;Route after the semicolon)
field_docs.approval_date: Product approval date, YYYY-MM-DD; products approved before 1982 read 'Approved Prior to Jan 1, 1982'
field_docs.reference_listed_drug: yes if the product is a reference listed drug (RLD), else no
field_docs.marketing_category: prescription, over the counter, or discontinued
field_docs.patent_no: US patent number (RE = reissue); patent rows only
field_docs.pediatric_extension: yes if the Orange Book lists this patent with *PED (six-month paediatric exclusivity added to the patent); patent rows only
field_docs.patent_expiry: Patent expiry date as listed (including any term extension and paediatric extension), YYYY-MM-DD; patent rows only
field_docs.drug_substance_claim: yes if the applicant flagged that the patent claims the drug substance; patent rows only
field_docs.drug_product_claim: yes if the applicant flagged that the patent claims the drug product; patent rows only
field_docs.patent_use_code: FDA patent use code (e.g. U-141) for a method-of-use patent; code descriptions are not in the data files; patent rows only
field_docs.delist_requested: yes if the applicant has requested that the patent be delisted; patent rows only
field_docs.patent_submitted: Date the patent was submitted to the FDA, YYYY-MM-DD, when given; patent rows only
field_docs.exclusivity_code: FDA exclusivity code (e.g. NCE, ODE-123, PED, I-975, PC, GAIN); exclusivity rows only
field_docs.exclusivity_expiry: Exclusivity expiry date, YYYY-MM-DD; exclusivity rows only

fda_purple_book.name: US FDA Purple Book: licensed biological products and exclusivity
fda_purple_book.licence: Public domain (U.S. government work): FDA website content is not copyrighted and may be republished freely
fda_purple_book.attribution: Source: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, Purple Book: Database of Licensed Biological Products (monthly data download). Not endorsed by the FDA.

field_docs.product_number: Product number within the BLA; bla_number + product_number identify a product
field_docs.proprietary_name: Proprietary (brand) name; 'N/A' where the source has none
field_docs.proper_name: Proper (non-proprietary) name, including any four-letter suffix
field_docs.marketing_status: Rx, OTC, Disc (discontinued) or Disc* as given by the FDA
field_docs.approval_date: Approval date of the product, YYYY-MM-DD
field_docs.interchangeable_approval_date: Date the product was approved as interchangeable, YYYY-MM-DD
field_docs.ref_product_proper_name: For 351(k) products: proper name of the reference product
field_docs.ref_product_proprietary_name: For 351(k) products: brand name of the reference product
field_docs.license_number: US licence number of the licence holder (an establishment number, not a person)
field_docs.center: FDA centre that regulates the product: CDER or CBER
field_docs.date_of_first_licensure: Date of first licensure for 12-year reference product exclusivity, YYYY-MM-DD, or text such as 'Not Eligible'
field_docs.exclusivity_expiry: Exclusivity expiration date column of the FDA file, YYYY-MM-DD (often empty)
field_docs.first_interchangeable_exclusivity_expiry: End of first-interchangeable exclusivity, YYYY-MM-DD, or text such as 'Date TBD'
field_docs.ref_product_exclusivity_expiry: End of 12-year reference product exclusivity, YYYY-MM-DD
field_docs.orphan_exclusivity_expiry: End of 7-year orphan drug exclusivity, YYYY-MM-DD
field_docs.patent_list_provided: yes if a patent list has been provided for the product
field_docs.data_month: Monthly Purple Book release the row comes from, YYYY-MM

fda_warning_letters.name: US FDA: warning letters about human drugs, biologics and medical devices (2021 onwards)
fda_warning_letters.licence: Public domain, U.S. government work (FDA website policies: "Unless otherwise noted, the contents of the FDA website (www.fda.gov), both text and graphics, are not copyrighted. They are in the public domain and may be republished, reprinted and otherwise used freely by anyone without the need to obtain permission from FDA. Credit to the U.S. Food and Drug Administration as the source is appreciated but not required.")
fda_warning_letters.attribution: Source: U.S. Food and Drug Administration, warning letters listing (fda.gov). Not endorsed by the FDA. A warning letter states FDA's view at the time it was issued; check the letter and any close-out letter on fda.gov before relying on it.
fields_never: letter text and the listing's search excerpt
names of individuals the letter is addressed to (clinical investigators, IRB members, sole traders): company, url and fda_case_number are blanked for these rows
recipient names, titles and addresses inside the letters
tobacco, human food, dietary supplement and veterinary (animal drug and animal food) letters (out of scope)

field_docs.company: Company (legal entity, with any 'dba' trading name) the letter was issued to, as FDA lists it; empty when the recipient is or may be an individual (see company_withheld)
field_docs.company_withheld: "yes" when Airmid blanked the recipient name, URL and case number because the recipient is or may be a person (clinical investigator or IRB subject, credentials such as M.D. or Ph.D., or no sign of an organisation in the name); else "no"
field_docs.issuing_office: FDA centre or office that issued the letter, as FDA lists it (e.g. Center for Drug Evaluation and Research (CDER), Center for Devices and Radiological Health)
field_docs.subject: Subject line FDA gives the letter (e.g. CGMP/Finished Pharmaceuticals/Adulterated)
field_docs.product_area: Human medical product area(s) the letter concerns, derived by Airmid from the issuing office and subject: drugs, biologics, devices
field_docs.posted_date: Date FDA posted the letter on fda.gov (YYYY-MM-DD)
field_docs.response_letter_date: Date of the company's posted response letter, if FDA posted one; empty otherwise (a non-empty value is the response letter flag)
field_docs.closeout_date: Date of FDA's close-out letter (FDA judged the violations addressed); empty while not closed out
field_docs.fda_case_number: FDA case (MARCS-CMS) number taken from the letter's URL; empty when withheld
field_docs.url: Letter page on fda.gov; empty when withheld

medicaid_drug_spending.name: US Medicaid State Drug Utilization Data: national prescriptions and amounts reimbursed by NDC product and year
medicaid_drug_spending.publisher: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), data.medicaid.gov, datasets "State Drug Utilization Data YYYY"; product names from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration National Drug Code Directory
medicaid_drug_spending.endpoint: https://data.medicaid.gov/api/1/datastore/query/{dataset id}/0 (server-side sums of national rows, state = XX) ; https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cder/ndctext.zip ; https://www.accessdata.fda.gov/cder/ndc_excluded.zip
medicaid_drug_spending.licence: Public domain (U.S. government work). CMS declares each SDUD dataset's licence on data.medicaid.gov as the U.S. Public Domain label ("license": "https://www.usa.gov/publicdomain/label/1.0/", dataset metadata). 17 U.S.C. § 105: "Copyright protection under this title is not available for any work of the United States Government". The FDA NDC Directory used for product names is likewise a U.S. government work (openFDA also publishes it under CC0 1.0: "You can copy, modify, distribute, and perform the work, even for commercial purposes, all without asking permission.", https://open.fda.gov/terms/). No endorsement by CMS or FDA may be implied.
medicaid_drug_spending.attribution: Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, State Drug Utilization Data (https://data.medicaid.gov), national totals summed by NDC product and year by Airmid Éireann; product names from the U.S. FDA National Drug Code Directory. Not endorsed by CMS or FDA. Amounts are reimbursed amounts before manufacturer rebates, not net spending.
fields_never: state-level rows (only CMS's national XX rows are used)
quarter, utilisation type (fee-for-service / managed care) and package size (summed to product and year)
non-Medicaid amount reimbursed (equals total minus Medicaid amount)
suppressed rows (CMS publishes no amounts for fewer than 11 prescriptions)
any prescriber, pharmacy or patient detail (SDUD holds none)

field_docs.year: Calendar year (sum of the four quarters). The window is the three latest years with all four quarters published.
field_docs.ndc_product: 9-digit National Drug Code product, labeler-product (LLLLL-PPPP); all package sizes of the product are summed
field_docs.labeler_code: NDC labeler code (5 digits, keep as text)
field_docs.product_code: NDC product code (4 digits, keep as text)
field_docs.cms_product_name: Product name as published by CMS in SDUD, cut by CMS to 10 characters
field_docs.fda_proprietary_name: Brand (proprietary) name from the FDA NDC Directory; empty when the FDA files do not list the product
field_docs.fda_nonproprietary_name: Non-proprietary (generic) name from the FDA NDC Directory
field_docs.fda_substance_name: Active substance(s) from the FDA NDC Directory, ';'-separated as FDA writes them
field_docs.fda_labeler_name: Company that labels the product (labeler), from the FDA NDC Directory. Blanked when the name does not read as an organisation (no company word, more than one word, and fewer than 5 products listed); Airmid never publishes personal names, and a few small companies are blanked as a result
field_docs.fda_name_source: current = FDA NDC Directory current listings; excluded = FDA's file of delisted/excluded products; empty = not found in either (only cms_product_name is available)
field_docs.number_of_prescriptions: Prescriptions reimbursed by Medicaid nationally that year, from rows CMS did not suppress
field_docs.units_reimbursed: Units reimbursed (tablets, ml, grams ... as CMS defines the product's unit), summed over package sizes
field_docs.total_amount_reimbursed_usd: Total amount reimbursed in US dollars (Medicaid plus non-Medicaid share, e.g. patient co-pays and third-party payers), before manufacturer rebates. Rebates are confidential and not published per drug, so this is not net spending.
field_docs.medicaid_amount_reimbursed_usd: Amount reimbursed by Medicaid in US dollars, before manufacturer rebates; the figure usually reported as Medicaid drug spending (gross).

nadac_prices.name: US CMS: NADAC drug acquisition costs (latest weekly file, one row per NDC)
nadac_prices.publisher: U.S. Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (data.medicaid.gov)
nadac_prices.endpoint: https://data.medicaid.gov/api/1/datastore/query/{dataset}/0 (yearly dataset "NADAC (National Average Drug Acquisition Cost) YYYY", found via https://data.medicaid.gov/api/1/search)
nadac_prices.licence: U.S. Public Domain. The data.medicaid.gov catalogue record of every yearly NADAC dataset carries the licence https://www.usa.gov/publicdomain/label/1.0/ (U.S. Public Domain label). resources.data.gov (Open Licenses): "Data and content created by government employees within the scope of their employment are not subject to domestic copyright protection under 17 U.S.C. § 105. nadac_prices.attribution: Source: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, National Average Drug Acquisition Cost (NADAC), data.medicaid.gov. Not endorsed by CMS. NADAC is a US pharmacy acquisition-cost benchmark; it is not a price paid by patients or by Irish or European payers.
fields_never: earlier weekly files (52 weeks would be about 1.6 million rows, over the 40 MB size rule; only the latest weekly file is kept)
pharmacy-level survey responses (CMS publishes none; NADAC is already a national average)

field_docs.ndc: National Drug Code, 11 digits without hyphens (5-4-2), as CMS publishes it
field_docs.ndc_description: CMS description of the drug product (name, strength, form)
field_docs.nadac_per_unit: National Average Drug Acquisition Cost in US dollars per pricing unit
field_docs.pricing_unit: Unit the NADAC is priced per: EA (each, e.g. tablet), ML (millilitre) or GM (gram)
field_docs.effective_date: Date this NADAC took effect (YYYY-MM-DD); it changes when CMS revises the rate
field_docs.pharmacy_type_indicator: Pharmacy type the rate is based on, as CMS codes it (C/I = chain and independent retail pharmacies)
field_docs.otc: Y if the product is over-the-counter, N if not
field_docs.classification_for_rate_setting: CMS classification used for rate setting: G (generic), B (brand), B-ANDA (brand approved through an abbreviated new drug application), B-BIO (brand biologic)
field_docs.explanation_code: CMS explanation code(s) describing how the rate was set, comma separated; meanings are in CMS's NADAC methodology on medicaid.gov
field_docs.corresponding_generic_drug_nadac_per_uni: For a brand product, the NADAC per unit of the corresponding generic, when CMS gives one
field_docs.corresponding_generic_drug_effective_dat: Effective date of that corresponding generic NADAC (YYYY-MM-DD)
field_docs.as_of_date: Date of the weekly NADAC file the row comes from (YYYY-MM-DD); the same for every row

nhs_prescription_costs.name: NHS England Prescription Cost Analysis: monthly items and cost by BNF chemical substance
nhs_prescription_costs.publisher: NHS Business Services Authority (NHSBSA), Open Data Portal, dataset "Prescription Cost Analysis (PCA) Monthly Administrative Data"
nhs_prescription_costs.endpoint: https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/api/3/action/datastore_search_sql (one GROUP BY query plus one totals query per monthly table PCA_YYYYMM)
nhs_prescription_costs.licence: Open Government Licence v3.0 (the dataset's licence on the NHSBSA portal: "Open Government Licence 3.0 (United Kingdom)"). OGL v3: "You are free to: copy, publish, distribute and transmit the Information; adapt the Information; exploit the Information commercially and non-commercially for example, by combining it with other Information, or by including it in your own product or application." Condition: acknowledge the source and, where possible, link to the licence.
nhs_prescription_costs.attribution: Contains public sector information licensed under the Open Government Licence v3.0. Source: NHS Business Services Authority, Prescription Cost Analysis (PCA) Monthly Administrative Data (https://opendata.nhsbsa.net/dataset/prescription-cost-analysis-pca-monthly-data). Summed by BNF chemical substance and unit of measure by Airmid Éireann. Monthly PCA is management information, not an Official Statistic.
fields_never: region and ICB breakdowns (summed to England)
BNF presentation, SNOMED code and supplier name (summed to chemical substance)
dispenser account type and pharmacy advanced service (summed)
any prescriber, practice, pharmacy or patient detail (PCA holds none)

field_docs.year: Calendar year of dispensing. The window is the last three full years plus the current year to date (NHSBSA publishes with a two-month lag).
field_docs.year_month: Month of dispensing, YYYY-MM. A year's figures are the sum of its months.
field_docs.bnf_chemical_substance_code: British National Formulary chemical substance code (9 characters, keep as text: leading zeros matter). Chapters 20-23 are dressings, appliances and devices. The BNF re-codes substances now and then (January 2026 split 'BeclometDiprop/Formoterol' out of 'Beclometasone dipropionate'), so a code's series can start or stop mid-window; rows are kept as published.
field_docs.bnf_chemical_substance: BNF chemical substance name as published by NHSBSA
field_docs.unit_of_measure: Unit that total_quantity is counted in (tablet, ml, gram, capsule ...). A substance with presentations in several units has one row per unit; add items and nic_gbp across those rows, never total_quantity.
field_docs.items: Prescription items dispensed in the community in England (an item is one product on a prescription form, whatever the quantity)
field_docs.nic_gbp: Net Ingredient Cost in pounds sterling: the basic list price of the medicine before discounts, not the actual net cost to the NHS, and excluding dispensing fees. Covers items dispensed in the community in England only (not hospitals).

field_docs.record_basis: wikidata = a Wikidata company item; gleif_irish_group_entity = a legal entity with GLEIF legal jurisdiction IE that GLEIF lists as an ultimate child of the LEI of a Wikidata company in this dataset (no Wikidata item needed)
field_docs.wikidata_qid: Wikidata item id (Q...) of the company; blank for gleif_irish_group_entity rows
field_docs.label: English Wikidata label of the company
field_docs.irish_link: Why the company is included: country_ireland (P17 = Ireland), hq_in_ireland (P159 headquarters located in Ireland), irish_subsidiary_or_facility (an item in Ireland names it as parent P749, owner P127 or operator P137), organisation_in_ireland_of_sector_company (an organisation in Ireland whose parent/owner/operator is a sector company), lei_jurisdiction_ie (GLEIF legal jurisdiction of its LEI is IE)
field_docs.sector_basis: Wikidata class or industry that made it a pharma/biotech/medtech company (e.g. 'pharmaceutical company', 'biotechnology'); 'subsidiary of X' when included through a sector parent X; 'group of X' for GLEIF group entities
field_docs.via_wikidata_qid: For gleif_irish_group_entity rows: the Wikidata company (QID) whose LEI is the GLEIF ultimate parent
field_docs.hq_country: Country of the Wikidata headquarters location (P159 -> P17), English label
field_docs.parent_labels: English labels of parent_qids, same order
field_docs.stock_listings: Current stock exchange listings from Wikidata (P414 with ticker qualifier P249, statements with an end date or deprecated rank excluded), as 'Exchange:TICKER'
field_docs.opencorporates_id: Wikidata OpenCorporates organisation ID (P1320), e.g. ie/399192
field_docs.lei_source: Where the LEI comes from: wikidata_P1278 (Wikidata LEI property); gleif_by_cro_number (Wikidata item had no LEI; exactly one GLEIF record with jurisdiction IE is registered at the CRO, RA000402, under the matched CRO number); gleif_ultimate_child (group entity rows)
field_docs.gleif_legal_name: Legal name in the GLEIF LEI record
field_docs.gleif_jurisdiction: Legal jurisdiction in GLEIF (ISO 3166 country or subdivision, e.g. IE, US-DE)
field_docs.gleif_registration_status: GLEIF LEI registration status (ISSUED, LAPSED, RETIRED, ...)
field_docs.gleif_legal_city: City of the legal (registered) address in GLEIF; street lines are never collected
field_docs.gleif_legal_country: Country of the legal (registered) address in GLEIF
field_docs.gleif_registered_at: GLEIF registration-authority code (RA000402 = Companies Registration Office, Ireland)
field_docs.gleif_registered_as: Entity's number at that registration authority, as reported to GLEIF
field_docs.gleif_direct_parent_lei: LEI of the direct accounting-consolidating parent reported to GLEIF (blank if none reported or a reporting exception)
field_docs.gleif_ultimate_parent_lei: LEI of the ultimate accounting-consolidating parent reported to GLEIF
field_docs.wikidata_cro_number: Wikidata 'Companies Registration Office (Ireland) Registration Number' (P9679), as stated on Wikidata
field_docs.cro_company_number: Irish CRO company number, verified to exist in CRO open data (see cro_match_method)
field_docs.cro_company_name: Company name in CRO open data (whitespace collapsed)
field_docs.cro_company_status: Company status in CRO open data (Normal, Dissolved, ...)
field_docs.cro_company_type: Company type in CRO open data
field_docs.cro_registration_date: Date of incorporation in CRO open data (YYYY-MM-DD)
field_docs.cro_match_method: How the CRO number was found, identifier or exact name only: gleif_registered_as (GLEIF registration authority RA000402 + number), wikidata_P9679, wikidata_opencorporates_ie (OpenCorporates ID ie/N), exact_name_gleif (GLEIF legal name, IE jurisdiction, equals exactly one CRO name after normalisation), exact_name_wikidata_P1448 (Wikidata official name of an Irish item equals exactly one CRO name), exact_name_wikidata_label (English label of an Irish item, only when it ends in an Irish legal form such as plc/Limited/DAC, equals exactly one CRO name). Normalisation: upper case, & -> AND, punctuation removed, whitespace collapsed, trailing LTD/PLC/DAC/UC/CLG expanded. No fuzzy or partial matching; a name matching two or more CRO companies is left unmatched; blank = no match
